test_title: PYST 35: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select that option.**

It is important to imediately report a bullying incident to the trusted elders.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) imediately**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**imediately**" has a spelling error, the correct spelling is "**immediately**".
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• Please respond to my email **immediately**.
 
• The doctor arrived **immediately **after the accident.
 
 
 
• **Option 2) trusted** is correct and does not contain any spelling error.
 
 
• Example: I always confide in my **trusted **friend when I need advice.
 
 
 
• **Option 3) incident** is also correct and does not contain any spelling error.
 
 
• Example: The police are investigating the **incident **that happened last night.
 
 
 
• **Option 4) bullying** is also correct and does not contain any spelling error.
 
 
• Example: **Bullying **can have a negative impact on a person's mental health.
 
 
 
• In conclusion, the correct option that rectifies the spelling error is **option 1) immediately.**

**Correct Sentence:__ ***It is important to **__immediately__ **report a bullying incident to the trusted elders.*
